regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rhythm: 9 of 16 themes are eligible with no single dominant narrative (one_narrative=false, absorption=0.3). Base Metals & Copper leads Oil & Gas by a thin margin on a mean-revert tag, so leadership is contestable rather than entrenched. The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps=true), so eligible themes are not in confirmed downtrends.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the thin 0.11 margin between Base Metals & Copper and Oil & Gas resolves into a confirmed leadership handoff — the check is XEG.TO closing above XBM.TO on a 10-day relative basis, and the watch retires once that either happens or the margin re-widens back above 0.3 in Base Metals' favor.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The challenger theme shows the strongest durability_bar (0.61, tied with Pipelines) and a broad within-theme breadth of 0.571 — the highest cohesion among the top themes. It ranks #2 with a score of 1.545, only 0.11 behind the leader, and is eligible under the trend gate. Prefer the theme with higher durability and comparable momentum over the lower-durability leader.
evidence: ranks: ca_oil_gas score=1.545, rank=2, eligible=true, durability_bar=0.61, breadth=0.571
rotation: margin=0.11 between leader and challenger (thin leadership)
backtest_verdict: gate_helps=true (eligible themes are in healthy absolute trends)
theses.dissent: The theme has a 'mixed' hurst tag and is not the leader; Base Metals holds the top rank and may consolidate leadership rather than hand it off. Energy producer beta to WTI brings single-factor risk the detector does not model.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags XBM.TO by 3% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The prevailing narrative holds rank #1 with the highest raw score (1.655) and is eligible under the trend gate. It is not crowded (crowded=false, crowding_z=0.9) and has no confirmed challenger takeover, so the trend-following, vol-aware frame keeps it as a lean while leadership is intact. The 'mean-revert' hurst tag and sub-par durability (0.5) argue for low conviction, not avoidance.
evidence: ranks: ca_base_metals rank=1, score=1.655, eligible=true, crowded=false, durability_bar=0.5, breadth=0.556
rotation: leader=ca_base_metals with margin 0.11 to challenger
backtest_verdict: momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha — so treat leadership as intact, not predictive
theses.dissent: The theme's hurst_tag is explicitly mean-revert, a warning that the recent leadership may self-correct. Oil & Gas has a higher durability_bar (0.61 vs 0.5), suggesting stronger staying power even at a lower score.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO gives back its lead versus XEG.TO and trades at a discount to its 10-day prior return

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only crowded theme (crowded=true, crowding_z=1.16) while ranking #8 with a negative score (-0.21). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — but combined with weak momentum and a mid-pack position, the lean is to avoid allocating fresh attention here rather than overweight.
evidence: ranks: ca_tech rank=8, score=-0.21, crowded=true, crowding_z=1.16
guardrails.do_not_conclude: crowding/extension only DOWN-SIZES, never a sell or short
theses.dissent: The theme is still eligible under the trend gate, so its absolute trend is not broken. A crowded but intact uptrend can persist on reflexivity; avoidance may underperform if tech regains leadership.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 3% before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
